DIAGNOSIS READY: Slipped Capital Femoral Epiphysis (SCFE)

Given your normal inflammatory markers and imaging, but persistent pain and limping, this clinical picture is highly suggestive of SCFE. This condition often presents in overweight adolescents with normal initial X-rays. Have you noticed any recent weight gain or difficulty turning your leg inward at the hip?
